summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated payload unrelated to the package's declared purpose
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases and then uses that runtime to execute the sibling file `math_init.js` — a ~727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated `@bun-cjs` bundle with a shuffled string/constant table and mangled identifiers (`WV8StW`, `MmgoCP`, `bc3Kak`,...). The payload is not referenced from the library entry (`build/index.js`) and has no relationship to the package's advertised Slack/Teams content-conversion functionality. The combination of an alternate-runtime dropper, an obfuscated install-time payload decoupled from the declared purpose, and out-of-band execution that bypasses Node-focused inspection is the shape of an install-time-RCE dropper against the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
